open_points.subject: A17 component-wise opening of configuration and secret files
open_points.text: “the last component for reading with `O_NONBLOCK` as well, so a component that is no regular file is refused by the checks rather than waited on”
open_points.question: Is merely opening the final component with `O_NONBLOCK` and then checking that it is regular sufficient, or must opening every non-regular Linux file be guaranteed not to block even where Linux permits a device or filesystem to ignore or only partly honor `O_NONBLOCK`?
options: Require only the named `O_NONBLOCK` open followed by the regular-file check
Require a strict never-block guarantee for every non-regular final component
Declare Linux file types or filesystems that can block despite `O_NONBLOCK` unsupported
open_points.default_guess: Use the named `O_NONBLOCK` open and then reject anything whose opened descriptor is not a regular file; treat the explanatory never-wait claim as non-guaranteed where Linux does not guarantee it.
